connector.name: Docker Compose Audit
connector.registryDescription: Security audit for docker-compose.yml - 25 checks: secrets, privileges, network, volumes, images.
connector.summary: Hosted at unbearable-dev--docker-compose-audit.apify.actor over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the unbearabledev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
